decisions.reason: Despite some rising risk of later portfolio simplification, this box car trailer series represents a visible and invested commitment in the firm's core trailer business, so management would still be inclined to continue it.

The car transporter trailer line remains close to the firm's production know-how and strategic direction, and disappointing performance could still be framed as temporary market-related rather than a reason to reverse course.
As a prominently presented low-bed trailer series in the core transport range, it carries strong sunk-cost and reputational commitment that makes withdrawal within the coming year unlikely.

Although overlap with other box trailer offerings raises some chance of consolidation, management would usually persist because of prior development effort, public market presence, and the product's fit with the established business.
